manifest.release_notes:
SwiftEdge 1.3.6
- Printer helpers: the Windows and Linux helper installers can be downloaded on a new install (Admin, Printer helpers), so USB printers can be connected.
- Windows: uninstalling after an update removes every program link cleanly.

SwiftEdge 1.3.5
- Credit book: regulars who pay later, SMS reminders, statements.
- Wholesale prices for resellers and bulk buyers.
- Tills keep selling when the server is off; M-Pesa codes are checked after.
- Lay-by: goods set aside while a customer pays in instalments.
- Staff clock-in and clock-out, and staff hours.
- Takeaway and delivery orders; open tabs on the floor.
- Table reservations.
- Detailed error reports and a five-minute heartbeat to SwiftEdge (after activation).
- Fixes: menu page with a new business, price check, quick taps on a dish, recovery sheet commands on Windows.
- Counter: quick scans are added in turn, none lost.
- Windows: the server opens its own address (no certificate warning); installer fixes from the first real install.
